title: Call the plain implementation
explanation: present accepts MessageFormatter. The referenced object is a PlainFormatter, so its format method runs and trims the text.

title: Substitute a tagged implementation
explanation: The variable still has type MessageFormatter but now refers to a TaggedFormatter. The same present method calls that object's format method. Reassigning the reference does not transform the earlier object.

title: Check the shared contract
explanation: Both implementations reject blank input. Their Java signatures alone do not enforce that semantic agreement; the shared contract tests check it.
